user.title: Connect your SmartEVSE
user.description: Pick the entities your SmartEVSE already publishes over MQTT. You can add more (for reconciliation, notifications, exports) after setup via the gear icon.

data.name: Name
data.energy_sensor: Cumulative imported energy / MID meter sensor (evimportactiveenergy)

abort.already_configured: A SmartEVSE with this name is already configured.

entities.title: Extra entities
entities.description: Optional. Adding the EVSE's own lifetime energy counter enables the nightly completeness check.

data.total_energy_sensor: Total energy charged sensor (evtotalenergycharged) — enables the nightly check
data.current_sensor: Charge current sensor — logged with each session for context
data.mode_entity: Mode entity (e.g. select.smartevse_xxxx_mode) — logged with each session for context

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.description: Sent through an existing Home Assistant notify service, e.g. notify.email_me or notify.mobile_app_phone. A persistent notification in Home Assistant is always created for completeness-check issues, regardless of this setting.

data.watchdog_enabled: Hourly watchdog (recovers a session if a charging event was ever missed)
data.reconcile_time: Time to run the nightly check

export_csv.name: Export sessions to CSV
export_csv.description: Writes a CSV of charge sessions for the given period to /config/www/smartevse_session_logger/ and returns the path, URL and totals.

config_entry_id.name: Logger
config_entry_id.description: Which SmartEVSE Session Logger instance, if you have more than one.

period.name: Period
period.description: A preset period. Ignored if start_date and end_date are both given.

force_reconciliation.name: Run completeness check now
force_reconciliation.description: Runs the nightly completeness check immediately instead of waiting for its scheduled time.

config_entry_id.name: Logger
config_entry_id.description: Which SmartEVSE Session Logger instance, if you have more than one.
